instructions: Tools that control a running Autodesk Navisworks Manage/Simulate 2026-2027 through the MCP Bridge plugin. The bridge does not start on its own: if a tool says it is not reachable, ask the user to click 'MCP Bridge' on the 'AI companion' ribbon tab in Navisworks. A modal dialog in Navisworks (missing files, errors) blocks every call until someone closes it. Opening, refreshing and saving models and running clash tests can take many minutes on large federated models.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify the Navisworks addin is running and reachable on localhost:8765.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Return metadata for the currently open Navisworks document.

tools.name: get_model_statistics
tools.description: Element counts grouped by class.

tools.name: get_model_tree
tools.description: Tree of sub-model files (.nwd/.nwc/.ifc/...) in the open document, flat in pre-order with a depth per node. Does not descend into geometry.

tools.name: select_files
tools.description: Select whole sub-models by file name (names from get_model_tree, with or without extension). Walks only the sub-model file tree, never the geometry, so it is fast on large federated models - use it instead of find_items_by_name for sub-models. contains=true matches substrings.

tools.name: color_files
tools.description: Override the color (RGB 0-255) of whole sub-models picked by file name, like select_files; does not change the selection.

tools.name: list_clash_tests
tools.description: List all clash tests in the current document with their status and result counts.

tools.name: create_clash_test
tools.description: Create a Clash Detective test. selectionA / selectionB optionally name selection-sets or search-sets to populate the test with on creation.

selectionA.description: Name of a selection-set or search-set for side A.

selectionB.description: Name of a selection-set or search-set for side B.

tools.name: set_clash_selections
tools.description: Attach selection-sets / search-sets to side A and/or side B of an existing clash test.

tools.name: run_clash_test
tools.description: Run a clash test by name, or all tests if name omitted.

tools.name: get_clash_results
tools.description: Return clash results for a named test.

tools.name: delete_clash_test
tools.description: Delete a clash test by name.

tools.name: create_clash_group
tools.description: Create an (empty) clash group inside an existing clash test.

tools.name: list_clash_groups
tools.description: List clash groups inside a clash test, with the names of their child clash results.

tools.name: delete_clash_group
tools.description: Delete a clash group (and its child results) from a clash test.

tools.name: add_clashes_to_group
tools.description: Move existing (ungrouped) clash results from a clash test into one of its clash groups. Already-grouped clashes are left alone; pass them by their display name (e.g. 'Clash1').

clash_names.description: Display names of clashes to move into the group.

tools.name: set_clash_group_status
tools.description: Set the review status of a clash group (New | Active | Reviewed | Approved | Resolved).

tools.name: list_sets
tools.description: List every selection set, search set and folder (Navisworks Sets window) with its path ('Folder/Sub/Set'), type (selection / search / folder), folder and, for selection sets and folders, the number of items.

tools.name: create_selection_set
tools.description: Save the current selection as a selection set. The name may be a path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100'): missing folders are created. Refuses to overwrite a set of the same name in that folder unless replace=true.

name.description: Set name, or a path with folders.

folder.description: Folder to put the set into (created if missing).

replace.description: Overwrite a set with the same name in that folder.

tools.name: get_selection_set_items
tools.description: List the elements stored in a named selection set.

tools.name: create_search_set
tools.description: Save a search set (re-evaluated whenever it is used) with the same conditions as find_items: AND conditions, any_of OR-groups, all operators, optional scope. Returns the current number of matches.

name.description: Name of the search set.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

any_of.description: OR-groups: an item matches if all conditions of ANY group hold (plus all of 'conditions'). E.g. [[Type=IfcWall],[Type=IfcSlab]].

scope.description: Search the whole document or only inside the current selection.

set_name.description: Search only inside this saved selection/search set.

files.description: Search only inside these sub-model files.

prune_below_match.description: Do not look inside an item that already matched (Navisworks default).

replace.description: Overwrite an existing set with this name.

folder.description: Folder for the saved search set (created if missing); the set name may also be a path.

tools.name: execute_search_set
tools.description: Run a saved search and return the count of matching elements.

tools.name: delete_set
tools.description: Delete a set or a folder. A folder that is not empty is deleted only with recursive=true (with everything in it).

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

recursive.description: Allow deleting a non-empty folder with its contents.

tools.name: create_set_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the Sets window; a path ('ОВ/Трубы') creates the missing parent folders too.

tools.name: rename_set
tools.description: Rename a selection set, search set or folder (it stays where it is).

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

tools.name: move_set
tools.description: Move a set or folder into another folder (created if missing; '' = top level) and/or to a position in it (0 = first). Without folder it is only reordered.

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

folder.description: Target folder path; '' for the top level. Omit to stay in the same folder.

position.description: Index in the target folder (0 = first). Default: last.

tools.name: update_selection_set
tools.description: Change a selection set from the current selection, like Update in the Sets window: mode replace (the set becomes the selection), add (selection added) or remove (selection taken out). The set keeps its name and place.

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

tools.name: update_search_set
tools.description: Give a search set new conditions (same form as find_items / create_search_set: conditions, any_of, operators, scope). The set keeps its name and place; returns the old and new conditions and the new number of matches.

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

any_of.description: OR-groups: an item matches if all conditions of ANY group hold (plus all of 'conditions'). E.g. [[Type=IfcWall],[Type=IfcSlab]].

set_name.description: Search only inside this saved selection/search set.

files.description: Search only inside these sub-model files.

prune_below_match.description: Do not look inside an item that already matched (Navisworks default).

tools.name: get_set_info
tools.description: Details of one set or folder: type, folder, for a search set its conditions in readable form and scope, the number of items, items per file and the first items; for a folder its contents.

name.description: Set or folder: its path ('ОВ/Трубы/DN100') or just its name (first match anywhere).

time_limit_s.description: Stop running a search set after this many seconds.

tools.name: find_items
tools.description: Find items by property conditions, like Navisworks' Find Items: several conditions (AND), OR-groups (any_of), operators equals / not_equals / > / >= / < / <= / contains / wildcard / has_property... Values are matched in the property's own type (numbers, lengths, angles, yes/no, dates); decimals are compared with a small tolerance. Get exact category/property names from list_property_names and values from list_property_values. Can select the result or save it as a search set. Native search, safe on large models; stops at max_results / time_limit_s.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Item', 'Element', 'IFC'. See list_property_names.

property.description: Property name, e.g. 'Type', 'Level', 'Elevation'. Not needed for has_category / not_has_category.

value.description: Value to compare with, as list_property_values shows it: text, a number (lengths in document units, '-0.07 m' is fine), degrees for angles, yes/no, yyyy-MM-dd for dates. wildcard uses * and ?.

any_of.description: OR-groups: an item matches if all conditions of ANY group hold (plus all of 'conditions'). E.g. [[Type=IfcWall],[Type=IfcSlab]].

scope.description: Search the whole document or only inside the current selection.

set_name.description: Search only inside this saved selection/search set.

files.description: Search only inside these sub-model files.

prune_below_match.description: Do not look inside an item that already matched (Navisworks default).

limit.description: How many found items to list in the answer.

save_as_search_set.description: Also save these conditions as a search set with this name.

replace.description: Overwrite an existing set with the save_as_search_set name.

folder.description: Folder for the saved search set (created if missing); the set name may also be a path.

tools.name: find_items_by_name
tools.description: Quick search by element name (substring match). Walks every element of the model: slow on large federated models. To pick whole sub-models by file name use select_files / color_files instead.

tools.name: select_all
tools.description: Select everything (Navisworks 'Select All'): the model roots are selected, which covers every element. Safe on large models.

tools.name: deselect_all
tools.description: Clear the current selection.

tools.name: invert_selection
tools.description: Invert the current selection with Navisworks' own inversion: the result is the smallest set of tree branches covering everything not selected.

tools.name: select_from_set
tools.description: Replace the current selection with the contents of a named set.

tools.name: get_current_selection
tools.description: Return the elements currently selected in the viewport (first 100), each with its hidden flag.

tools.name: get_element_properties
tools.description: Return all property tabs and values for the first selected element (or by name).

tools.name: list_property_names
tools.description: Which property categories and properties exist (Navisworks Properties window), with the number of items that have each, its data type and a sample value. Use it before find_items / create_search_set / list_property_values to get exact category and property names instead of guessing. The walk stops at max_items or time_limit_s (truncated=true): on a large federated model narrow it with files, set_name or scope=selection.

scope.description: Items to look at: the whole document or the current selection (with everything inside it).

set_name.description: Look at a saved selection/search set instead.

files.description: Look at these sub-model files only (names as in list_model_files / get_model_tree).

category.description: Only this category (display or internal name), e.g. 'Element' or 'IFC'.

tools.name: list_property_values
tools.description: Distinct values of one property with the number of items for each (most frequent first), plus min/max for numeric properties. Use it to see what to search for, e.g. all levels, systems or diameters. Same scope and limits as list_property_names.

category.description: Property category (display or internal name), from list_property_names.

property.description: Property (display or internal name), from list_property_names.

scope.description: Items to look at: the whole document or the current selection (with everything inside it).

set_name.description: Look at a saved selection/search set instead.

files.description: Look at these sub-model files only (names as in list_model_files / get_model_tree).

max_values.description: Return at most this many distinct values.

tools.name: export_properties
tools.description: Write properties of many items to a CSV file (one row per item: File, Path, Name, Class, then the properties) for quality checks, quantity lists or comparison in Excel. Values as list_property_values shows them (lengths with the document unit). Choose columns with properties ['Category/Property', ...] or categories (all their properties); without both every property found becomes a column (up to max_columns). UTF-8 with BOM. The walk stops at max_items / time_limit_s (truncated=true).

categories.description: Without properties: every property of these categories becomes a column.

require_property.description: Only items that have this 'Category/Property', e.g. 'IFC/GlobalId' for real elements without their geometry nodes.

level.description: all = every item in the scope with everything inside; geometry = only items with geometry; top = only the selected / set items themselves.

set_name.description: Export the items of this selection / search set.

delimiter.description: Column separator: ',' (default), ';' for Excel with German / Russian settings, or 'tab'.

tools.name: color_elements
tools.description: Override the color (RGB 0-255) of currently selected elements.

tools.name: set_transparency
tools.description: Override transparency (0.0 opaque .. 1.0 fully transparent) of selected elements.

tools.name: reset_overrides
tools.description: Remove every color and transparency override and unhide everything.

tools.name: hide_elements
tools.description: Hide the current selection or a saved selection/search set (Navisworks 'Hide').

set_name.description: Selection or search set to hide instead of the current selection.

tools.name: hide_unselected
tools.description: Hide everything except the current selection or a saved set (Navisworks 'Hide Unselected'). The kept items are made visible even if they were hidden. Uses Navisworks' own inversion, safe on large federated models. hiddenBranches counts hidden tree branches, not single elements.

set_name.description: Selection or search set to keep instead of the current selection.

tools.name: unhide_all
tools.description: Show every hidden element (Navisworks 'Unhide All'). Fast on any model size.

tools.name: unhide_children
tools.description: Show the current selection or a saved set together with everything inside it (Navisworks 'Unhide Children'), e.g. bring back one file of a hidden model.

set_name.description: Selection or search set to show instead of the current selection.

tools.name: isolate_elements
tools.description: Same as hide_unselected: show only the current selection or a saved set.

set_name.description: Selection or search set to keep instead of the current selection.

tools.name: list_viewpoints
tools.description: List saved viewpoints and folders (Saved Viewpoints window) with path, type (viewpoint / folder / animation), folder and whether a viewpoint stores hidden items and colour overrides; 'current' is the viewpoint selected in the window.

tools.name: save_viewpoint
tools.description: Save the current view (camera, section) as a viewpoint. The name may be a path: missing folders are created. with_overrides=true also stores hidden items and colour / transparency overrides, so goto_viewpoint brings them back. Refuses to overwrite unless replace=true (or use update_viewpoint).

name.description: Viewpoint name, or a path with folders.

folder.description: Folder to save into (created if missing).

with_overrides.description: Also store hidden items and colour / transparency overrides.

replace.description: Overwrite a viewpoint with the same name in that folder.

tools.name: goto_viewpoint
tools.description: Go to a saved viewpoint as if it was clicked in the Saved Viewpoints window: camera and section and, if the viewpoint stores them, hidden items and colour overrides (these replace the current ones).

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere).

apply_overrides.description: Apply stored hidden items and colours (false = camera only).

tools.name: delete_viewpoint
tools.description: Delete a viewpoint or a folder. A folder that is not empty is deleted only with recursive=true.

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere).

recursive.description: Allow deleting a non-empty folder with its contents.

tools.name: get_current_viewpoint
tools.description: Camera of the current view: position, direction, up, target, projection, field of view (degrees) or orthographic height, focal distance, speeds, lighting, render style, section box.

tools.name: get_viewpoint
tools.description: Full camera of a saved viewpoint (or of the current view without name): position, direction, up, target, projection, field of view or orthographic height, focal distance, speeds, lighting, render style, section; for a saved one also how many hidden items and colour overrides it stores.

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere). Omit for the current view.

include_camera_json.description: Also return the AutodeskCommonCamera JSON (can be passed back as camera_json).

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Change camera settings of the current view, or of a saved viewpoint (name) without touching its hidden items and colours. Only what is passed changes. Positions in document units, angles in degrees; with target or direction the picture is kept upright (world up, else +Z) unless up is given.

name.description: Saved viewpoint to change. Omit to change the current view.

target.description: Point to look at [x, y, z] (sets focal distance too).

direction.description: View direction [x, y, z] (instead of target).

fov_deg.description: Vertical field of view, perspective camera.

linear_speed.description: Walk / fly speed, document units per second.

tools.name: update_viewpoint
tools.description: Update a saved viewpoint from the current view (Update in the Saved Viewpoints window): camera, section, redlines and visibility; it keeps its name and place.

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere).

tools.name: create_viewpoint_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the Saved Viewpoints window; a path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1') creates missing parents too.

tools.name: rename_viewpoint
tools.description: Rename a saved viewpoint or folder (it stays where it is).

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere).

tools.name: move_viewpoint
tools.description: Move a viewpoint or folder into another folder (created if missing; '' = top level) and/or to a position in it (0 = first).

name.description: Viewpoint or folder: its path ('Коллизии/Этаж 1/Узел 3') or just its name (first match anywhere).

folder.description: Target folder path; '' for the top level. Omit to stay in the same folder.

position.description: Index in the target folder (0 = first). Default: last.

tools.name: list_model_files
tools.description: List the files loaded in the current document with their index, whether the file and its source (e.g. the IFC) exist on disk, and modification times. An appended .nwf expands into its files; an appended .nwd is one entry whose 'contains' lists the files it was built from. Use the index with remove_file.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open an .nwf/.nwd/.nwc or any supported source file, replacing the current document. Refuses if the current document has unsaved changes unless discard_changes is true. Navisworks may show a dialog (e.g. missing files) that someone has to close.

path.description: Full path of the file to open.

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Clear the current document (File > New).

tools.name: append_files
tools.description: Append one or more files (IFC, NWC, NWD, NWF, RVT, DWG, ...) to the current document.

tools.name: remove_file
tools.description: Remove a loaded file from the current document, by index or by name (as shown by list_model_files). Prefer index when names repeat.

name.description: Model name or file name, e.g. 'ARC.ifc'.

tools.name: update_files
tools.description: Reload every loaded file that changed on disk since it was loaded (the 'Refresh' command). Returns the file list afterwards.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the current document as .nwf (references the source files) or .nwd (everything embedded). Without path, saves over the current file. version picks the file format: 'current' (default) or a year from 2015 on, e.g. '2026' so Navisworks 2026 can open a file saved in 2027. 2016-2025 share one format. Saving .nwd keeps the open document as it is (keep_open, default); keep_open=false makes the .nwd the open document, its files collapsing into one model - needed before publish_nwd.

tools.name: publish_nwd
tools.description: Publish the open .nwd to a new .nwd with export options: format version, embedded external references, without hidden items, or without object properties (for handing a model to third parties). Works only while an .nwd is the open document (Navisworks restriction).

tools.name: convert_to_nwd
tools.description: Convert files to .nwd one by one: open each file and save it as <name>.nwd next to it or in output_dir. Replaces the current document while running and reopens it at the end (restore_document).

tools.name: get_model_transform
tools.description: Position of loaded models, as in Navisworks' Units and Transform dialog: units, translation [x, y, z] (document units), rotation (angle in degrees about an axis), scale [x, y, z], reflection, and the model's bounding box (min / max / center, document units). Without index or name: all models. The transform already holds what the file brings: an IFC's georeference shows up as a translation (e.g. 685198, 5379841, 434 m) and a file in mm as units Millimeters - that is normal. A model whose box is far from the others usually came with a shifted insertion point.

name.description: Model name or file name, e.g. 'ARC.ifc'.

tools.name: set_model_transform
tools.description: Move, rotate or scale one loaded model, or change its units - Navisworks' Units and Transform dialog. Pass only what changes. mode 'set' replaces the values (like the dialog), 'add' applies them on top of the current position (translation added, rotation added, scale multiplied). Changing units rescales the model (mm read as m = 1000 times too big). Returns the position before and after. Only models listed by list_model_files can be moved: an appended .nwf expands into its files, an appended .nwd is one model (to move a file inside it, open the .nwf it was built from). The position is stored in the open .nwf/.nwd: save the document afterwards and rebuild the files that append it.

name.description: Model name or file name, e.g. 'ARC.ifc'.

rotation_axis.description: Rotation axis [x, y, z]; default [0, 0, 1] (about Z).

scale.description: [x, y, z], or one number for all axes.

tools.name: reset_model_transform
tools.description: Undo the position changes made through the bridge: put one model back to the units and transform it had when the bridge first read it in the open document (opening or clearing a document forgets that). Not a reset to zero - that would drop the file's own georeference. Answers changed=false if the model was not changed through the bridge.

name.description: Model name or file name, e.g. 'ARC.ifc'.

tools.name: capture_view
tools.description: Render the current Navisworks view and return it as an image, so you can see the model. Optionally also save the PNG to save_path.

height.description: Default keeps the view's aspect ratio.

tools.name: zoom_to_elements
tools.description: Zoom the camera to the current selection, or to a selection/search set.

tools.name: set_section_box
tools.description: Turn on a section box around the current selection or a set, and zoom to it.

tools.name: clear_section
tools.description: Switch sectioning off in the current view.

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Return the current view's sectioning as Navisworks ClipPlaneSet JSON.

tools.name: get_clash_summary
tools.description: Per clash test: last run, total results, counts by status, number of groups.

tools.name: set_clash_result_status
tools.description: Set the status of individual clash results (also inside groups).

tools.name: assign_clashes
tools.description: Assign clash results to a person or company. Empty assignee unassigns.

tools.name: add_clash_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to clash results.

tools.name: zoom_to_clash
tools.description: Show one clash like Clash Detective does: select both items, colour item 1 red and item 2 green, zoom to it. section=true adds a section box; capture=true also returns an image of the view.

padding.description: Margin in model units; default = size of the clash box.

tools.name: auto_group_clashes
tools.description: Group all ungrouped results of a top-level clash test in one go. group_by: 'model' (file of item A/B, default both: 'A.ifc × B.ifc'), 'level' (nearest storey/level node, else Element/Level property), or 'property' (category + property display names, read from the item or its ancestors). side: a, b or both.

prefix.description: Text put before every group name.

tools.name: export_clash_report
tools.description: Write a clash report as .csv (opens in Excel) or .html: test, group, clash, status, distance, assignee, items and their model files, centre point, comments.
